results.title: The Other Asian Giant: How India Could Build an Alternative to Chinese Power - Australian Institute of International Affairs
results.snippet: India’s alternative to Chinese power remains a proposition under construction. It will be persuasive if neighbours gain reliable access to markets and industries gain credible options when supplies are disrupted. The Nepal–Bangladesh transaction shows what this can look like on a small scale. Expanding that logic would allow India to shape Asia’s future while giving other countries greater control
